stages.name: public HTTPS control plane and embedded UI
two synthetic sites and four public WSS Agent connections
public application login redirects secure cookies and uploads
site authorization isolation and unauthenticated rejection
Agent failure and public WSS reconnection
public bidirectional WebSocket and logout revocation

topology: One host; separate Server and four Agent processes, two synthetic sites. Console and two applications use separate Cloudflare Quick Tunnels. Agent WSS and browser HTTPS/WSS traverse public Cloudflare edges.
limitations: Single host/process isolation, not two physical private networks
Cloudflare Quick Tunnels do not support SSE; SSE is not tested
Not an HA, production capacity, real business application or IdP acceptance
